nvidia-this.description: this PC, proprietary NVIDIA driver accepted

files: /usr/local/bin/prime-run

#!/bin/sh
# Run a program on the NVIDIA GPU (PRIME render offload): prime-run glxgears
export __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=1
export __VK_LAYER_NV_optimus=NVIDIA_only
export __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia
exec "$@"
/etc/cron.weekly/fstrim
/etc/portage/env/installer-memory

# Written by the Gentoo installer: the compile jobs for packages that need a lot of memory per job.
MAKEOPTS="-j4"
/etc/portage/package.env/installer-hardware

# Written by the Gentoo installer: packages that need a lot of memory per compile job.
dev-python/pyside installer-memory
dev-qt/qtwebengine installer-memory
llvm-core/llvm installer-memory
llvm-core/clang installer-memory
net-libs/webkit-gtk installer-memory
notes: NVIDIA proprietary driver 595 (current, open kernel modules); if it fails to build, the open nouveau driver stays in use.
With 14.8 GiB of memory (and the swap), the packages that need about 4 GiB per compile job (pyside, qtwebengine, llvm, clang, webkit-gtk) get 4 compile jobs when they are built from source.
post_steps: if getent group pipewire >/dev/null; then usermod -aG pipewire "$1"; fi; exit 0

set -- /var/db/pkg/app-misc/hwmonux-*; if [ -f /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia.conf ] && [ -d "$1" ]; then echo 'app-misc/hwmonux nvidia' > /etc/portage/package.use/installer-hwmonux-nvidia && emerge --oneshot app-misc/hwmonux || { rm -f /etc/portage/package.use/installer-hwmonux-nvidia; echo 'HWMonux NVIDIA sensors skipped'; }; fi; exit 0
